description: This file defines the PartyContentWrapper class, which implements ContentWrapper to facilitate retrieving and rendering party-related content, including caching mechanisms, content fetching, and content rendering logic within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PartyContentWrapper
classes.description: Implements ContentWrapper to fetch and render party content with caching support within the OFBiz framework.
